text: Chapter 1 establishes the foundational equipment standards required to develop both hands effectively. The method prescribes **medium-heavy string gauge** (minimum .012 first string) and **medium-high action** to provide proper resistance and strengthen technique, with **accurate fret dressing** and a **medium to heavy celluloid pick** completing the guitar setup. Three essential non-guitar tools are required: a **metronome**, a **tape recorder** for self-monitoring, and a **timer**, enabling the timed and recorded practice central to the method. The chapter introduces the pedagogical axiom that **speed comes as a byproduct of accuracy** — without precision, speed is unattainable — and establishes the **note clarity standard** (each note should ring loud and clear across the fingerboard) as the verification criterion for proper setup.
